ब्रू {c2c} U. (ब्रवीति, ब्रूते or आह; this
root is defective in the
non-conjugational tenses, its forms being
made up from वच्)
1 To say, tell,
speak (with two acc.); तां… ब्रूया
एवं

; रामं यथास्थितं सर्वं भ्राता
ब्रूते स्म विह्वलः

; or
माणवकंधर्मं ब्रूते Sk.; किं त्वां प्रति ब्रूमहे

.
--2 To say or speak about, refer
to (a person or thing); अहं तु
शकुंतलामधिकृत्य ब्रबीमि Ś. 2.
--3 To
declare, proclaim, publish, prove,
indicate; ब्रुवत हि फलेत साधवो न तु कंठेन
निजोपयोगितां

.
--4
To name, call, designate; छंदसि दक्षा
ये कवयस्तन्मणिमध्यं ते ब्रुवते Śrut. 15.
--5 To answer; ब्रूहि मे प्रश्नान्.
--6 To
call or profess one self to be. --WITH
अनु to say, speak, declare.
--निस्
to explain, derive.
--प्र to say, speak,
tell;

.
--प्रति to speak in
reply, answer or reply; प्रत्यब्रवीच्चैनं

.
--वि {1} to say, speak.
{2} to speak falsely or wrongly.

ब्रुव, ब्रुवाण a. Professing or
pretending to be, calling oneself by a name
to which he has no real title (at
the end of comp.), as in ब्राह्मणब्रुव,
क्षत्रियब्रुव &c.
